name: microsoft-office-addin
description: Connect Codex to open Excel, Word, and PowerPoint task panes through Office.js.

interface.shortDescription: Read and edit open Office documents through Office.js.
interface.longDescription: Chat with Codex inside an Office task pane, with saved history, streamed replies, activity, and approval controls. Also connects the Codex desktop app to Office documents. Discover connected documents and run JavaScript in a specifically selected document's Office.js context. Scripts can read and write the document and have the task pane's normal JavaScript capabilities.
defaultPrompt: Set up Codex for Microsoft Office on this computer.
